name: Invoice Coordinator
tagline: Routes, matches and chases invoices so bills move instead of piling up
description: Keeps bills moving rather than collecting: new invoices get routed onward, the ones it can match against records are cleared automatically, actuals are tracked across vendors or campuses, and the responsible owner gets a nudge whenever something needs a human decision. The pile stops growing unnoticed.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
